recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If future profile-description issues arise for the migrated profiles, handle them in the current owning specification/repository rather than changing core for this R5 build-display issue.
issue_request: FHIR-39256 was a Published/Persuasive R5 change request for FHIR-core ValueSet. It reported that ComputableValueSet, ExecutableValueSet, PublishableValueSet, and ShareableValueSet all showed the same ValueSet Core package description on the ValueSet profiles page, while their individual profile pages had suitable distinct descriptions.
initial_application: No HL7/fhir source commit explicitly mentions FHIR-39256. The distinct profile descriptions were already present in the ValueSet profile StructureDefinitions from commit 93fadfaa2a89cdc46a2a2633431ebbc34f06fe74, so the defect was the generated profile-list display selecting the package description. Jira comments, TI minutes, and the R5 published page show the build/display issue was fixed before publication.
additional_context: FHIR-37959 later removed the Shareable/Publishable/Computable/Executable profiles from core for R6 and directed that they be maintained outside the core FHIR specification. Commit 3958dd1e7c2fd73ad1e94c66f8d0884df55695d5 deleted the ValueSet profile StructureDefinition source files and removed their ValueSet Core IG references; the current CI ValueSet profiles page reports no profiles defined for ValueSet.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. A source edit would not correct a current core build defect: R5 already displays the requested descriptions, and current R6 core no longer owns or renders those ValueSet profiles.

related_jiras.note: Applied/Persuasive R6 migration removed the affected ValueSet profiles from core and explains why FHIR-39256 has no current core source target.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive R5 issue reporting that four ValueSet profile rows displayed the same ValueSet Core package description instead of individual profile descriptions.
evidence_items.learned: The final approved resolution was a build/display correction, not a request to author new profile description source text.

evidence_items.summary: Added or updated the ValueSet profile StructureDefinition files with distinct description values for ComputableValueSet, ExecutableValueSet, PublishableValueSet, and ShareableValueSet.
evidence_items.learned: The individual descriptions were present in source before FHIR-39256 was applied, so the issue was the page renderer selecting the package description.

evidence_items.summary: The R5 ValueSet profiles table displays distinct descriptions for the four affected profiles.
evidence_items.learned: The published R5 page reflects the requested display behavior.

evidence_items.summary: Applied/Persuasive R6 decision to remove the Shareable/Publishable/Computable/Executable profiles from core and maintain them externally.
evidence_items.learned: This later decision explains why no current core source edit is appropriate for the old ValueSet profile display issue.

evidence_items.summary: Removed the ValueSet profile StructureDefinition source files and ValueSet Core IG resource references from core.
evidence_items.learned: The affected profiles are not current core build inputs.

evidence_items.summary: Current ValueSet Core implementation guide has only the generic package description and an empty definition after the profile migration.
evidence_items.learned: There is no current core ValueSet profile list entry where duplicated profile descriptions remain to be corrected.

evidence_items.summary: Minutes record that GG fixed an issue with how profile descriptions display and FHIR-39256 was marked applied.
evidence_items.learned: Work-group minutes corroborate the applied build/display fix.
